question: Why does one of the Riace warriors have copper lips and silver teeth?
answer: To stand out against bright metal. The two Greek bronzes of the 400s BC have lips, nipples and eyelashes inlaid in reddish copper, eyes of calcite, and one shows a row of silver teeth. Such contrasts only read on a polished surface close to tanned skin. The dark patina seen today is corrosion, not design.
move: Judge an old object by its first surface, not by what time added.
reference: Carol C. Mattusch, Classical Bronzes: The Art and Craft of Greek and Roman Statuary, Cornell University Press, 1996
